summary: PASS 8/8 pytest on the weather bug fix + regression endpoints (test_weather_fix.py). Live evidence from public URL: GET /api/weather/current?lat=35.5841&lon=-80.8685 returns {temp:70, code:0, text:'Clear', hi:78, lo:51} which matches Open-Meteo direct call (69.6°F → rounded 70°F). The user's complaint of a stuck 74°F reading is resolved — the endpoint no longer serves the ~4°F-high wttr.in fallback for 30 min. Verified: (a) shape has all 5 fields with numeric non-None temp/hi/lo, (b) endpoint temp is within 2°F of Open-Meteo direct (actual diff = 0°F), (c) warm repeat calls return in <3s with consistent value (cache working). Regression: /api/device/folly returns {e:[{y,t,v}], w, dir} with dir in {'in','out',None}; /api/device/lake returns {lvl,tgt,full,w} with numeric values; /api/teams/status?teams=MLB:NYY returns 200 with valid highlight enum and _iso_to_eastern_date('2026-09-30T00:05Z')=='2026-09-29' proving UTC→ET date rollback; /api/device/planes returns {p:[{f,al,d}]} with proper types. No 500s, no upstream failures observed this run.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py weather_current(): now honours per-source TTL via cached['ttl'] (600s for Open-Meteo, 240s for wttr.in). Correct — a cache hit uses whatever TTL the last successful source stored. This is the exact fix for 'stuck on wttr.in' behaviour.

server.py weather_current(): loops sources in order [(_wx_openmeteo, 600), (_wx_wttr, 240)] and only accepts a payload where d['temp'] is not None. Safe: prevents caching a 'null temp' from a partial upstream response.
server.py weather_current(): on total failure, returns last-good cached data (stale but not None) — good UX; no 500 leaked to the app.

server.py _iso_to_eastern_date(): correctly handles ISO with 'Z' by replacing with '+00:00' before fromisoformat, then converts via zoneinfo. Verified: '2026-09-30T00:05Z' → '2026-09-29'. Fixes 'game shown a day late' bug.
server.py device_folly(): 'dir' derived from events[0].y — 'in' if next event is High tide, 'out' if Low. Falls back to None when events list is empty. Sensible and cheap.

rca_of_issue: Root cause of the 74°F 'stuck' bug: prior weather_current() used a single 30-minute TTL for whichever source responded first. When Open-Meteo transiently failed and wttr.in returned (which reads ~4°F high at these coords), that warmer value got cached for 30 min — matching the user's report of a stale, wrong reading. Fix: prefer Open-Meteo (10-min TTL) and only cache the wttr.in fallback for 4 min, so we quickly retry the accurate source. Verified live: endpoint now reports 70°F matching Open-Meteo's 69.6°F (rounded), not the wttr.in-warmer number the user was seeing.
